commit 16837d0aba3b38c6db16db23bbac9d88050f5961
Author: HuaiNan <amy095200@gmail.com>
Date:   Wed Aug 19 11:18:47 2026 +0800

    fix: bound _seen_product_ids to stop unbounded memory growth
    
    get_recommendations() extended a module-level list (_seen_product_ids)
    with every incoming product id and never trimmed it (introduced in
    f18f452 "perf: track all seen product ids for analytics"). Under
    sustained load RSS grew monotonically until the container hit its
    memory limit and was OOM-killed (RestartCount=18 in prod before an
    online memory-limit bump + restart mitigated it).
    
    Replace the unbounded list with collections.deque(maxlen=1000) so the
    tracking structure self-evicts and memory stays flat regardless of
    request volume.
    
    Verified: python3 -m py_compile $(git ls-files '*.py') passes;
    pytest -v passes both tests, including test_memory_is_bounded which
    asserts growth < 1000 over 5000 requests (previously failed against
    the unbounded list).

+# s4 capstone: tiny runnable image for the recommendation service.
+# The leak revision self-drives load (background thread), so once running the
+# container's RSS climbs monotonically until the memory limit OOM-kills it.
+# Pure stdlib -> no pip install needed at build time.
+FROM python:3.11-slim
+
+WORKDIR /app
+COPY recommendation_server.py /app/
+
+ENV PORT=8080 \
+    LOAD_RPS=200 \
+    PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
+
+EXPOSE 8080
+CMD ["python", "recommendation_server.py"]

final_diagnosis.remediation_detail: 已执行低风险止血：docker restart recommendation（命中白名单 restart_instance，目标在授权列表内）。执行前 4 次 docker stats 采样显示内存单调上升 16.84→31.88→33.26→34.67→36.33 MiB（约40秒内，负载~400rps不变），重启后立即回落至 11.09MiB，确认止血生效。但这只是重置，不解决根因：当前部署镜像(recommendation-leak-fixture:test，digest与recommendation:f18f452/:latest相同)仍运行master分支上引入泄漏的f18f452版本代码——get_recommendations()把每个请求的product id append进模块级无界list `_seen_product_ids`，从不清理，等价于历史工单描述的"手动加全局缓存忘配TTL"。修复代码已经写好并提交在本地分支 fix/bounded-seen-product-ids-oom-20260819(commit 16837d0)，用 collections.deque(maxlen=1000) 替换无界list，但该分支从未合并到 master，线上镜像也从未用它重新构建/发布。根治动作：将16837d0合并进master并重新构建镜像替换当前部署，否则本次重启只能延后而非避免下一次OOM复发。
evidence: docker logs recommendation 显示 '[recommendation] serving on :9001 (leak revision)'，与 git show f18f452(修复前) 的print文案一致，确认当前运行的是泄漏版本代码
docker images 显示 recommendation-leak-fixture:test / recommendation:f18f452 / recommendation:latest 三个tag digest全部相同(9bb479aff0df)，确认线上部署的就是引入泄漏的f18f452构建
docker stats --no-stream recommendation 连续4次采样(约40秒,~400rps负载不变): 16.84MiB→31.88MiB→33.26MiB→34.67MiB→36.33MiB，内存单调上升，符合memory-oom手册的泄漏特征

cd workspace/recommendation && git log --all --oneline --decorate: master/origin/HEAD 停在 f18f452 'perf: track all seen product ids for analytics'；修复commit 16837d0 'fix: bound _seen_product_ids to stop unbounded memory growth' 只存在于本地未合并分支 fix/bounded-seen-product-ids-oom-20260819

git show 16837d0 的commit message明确写明: 'Under sustained load RSS grew monotonically until the container hit its memory limit and was OOM-killed (RestartCount=18 in prod before an online memory-limit bump + restart mitigated it)'，与本次告警描述的hist-2026-01事故一致
已执行处置: docker restart recommendation；重启后 docker inspect 显示 StartedAt 更新，docker stats 内存回落至 11.09MiB，止血生效
